purpose: Which delivery failures Relay 0.8.2 reports to a caller, and which it swallows.

config_report_shape.note: The typed ConfigReport declares runtime_diagnostics as required, but every validate, initialize and report call in this spike returned a mapping carrying only diagnostics. Techtree must read the key defensively and must not treat its absence as an assertion that delivery succeeded.

atof_stream_sink_closed_endpoint.sink: stream, http_post, closed loopback port, timeout 500ms
atof_stream_sink_closed_endpoint.finding: A stream sink that cannot deliver produces no diagnostic anywhere a caller can read: not in the initialize report, not in the runtime report, and not as a teardown failure.

atof_stream_sink_live_local_listener.sink: stream, http_post, a loopback listener inside the probe process
atof_stream_sink_live_local_listener.finding: Delivery is attempted once per event, not batched. Together with the closed-endpoint case this establishes that the silence above is a swallowed failure and not an unattempted one.

opentelemetry_endpoint_closed_via_plugin.sink: opentelemetry endpoint, type full, closed loopback port, timeout 500ms
opentelemetry_endpoint_closed_via_plugin.teardown_message_shape: registration failed: plugin teardown failed: observability registration 'nemo-relay-plugin.v1.observability:1:opentelemetry.shutdown' reported a delivery failure: ... otel.traces_export_failed (1): export to endpoint <url> has not recovered
opentelemetry_endpoint_closed_via_plugin.finding: The OpenTelemetry path does surface delivery failure, but only by raising from plugin teardown. A caller that tears down without catching loses the run instead of recording the diagnostic.

opentelemetry_subscriber_direct.force_flush: raises RuntimeError naming the failed export
opentelemetry_subscriber_direct.finding: Bounded, countable diagnostics exist for the direct OpenTelemetry subscriber only. There is no equivalent accessor on AtofExporter.

dropped_event_diagnostics.conclusion: Relay 0.8.2 exposes no dropped-event counter, no queue-depth reading and no delivery receipt for ATOF. Techtree cannot ask Relay whether an ATOF event was dropped, so a Techtree Relay evidence statement may never claim lossless delivery. Missing events are found only by comparing observed event identities against the coverage profile's declared expectations.
